# CRS Accounting
> CRS Accounting is a multi-currency hospitality and business accounting software designed for hotel, restaurant, and enterprise financial management.

## Overview
CRS Accounting provides financial dashboards, room revenue & occupancy tracking, guest invoicing, purchase invoices, daily revenue collections, accounts payable & expenses, capital & loans management, and standard financial reports including Balance Sheet, Income Statement (P&L), and Trial Balance.

## Application Endpoints
- [/login](https://accounting.crscentral.com/login): Secure user authentication and sign-in portal.
- [/](https://accounting.crscentral.com/): Primary financial dashboard and KPI overview.
- [/data-security](https://accounting.crscentral.com/data-security): Data security and compliance policies.
- [/privacy-policy](https://accounting.crscentral.com/privacy-policy): Privacy policy and data handling documentation.

## Core Capabilities
- Multi-currency transaction logging and automated FX rate conversion.
- Room revenue, CPOR (Cost Per Occupied Room), and PAR (Cost Per Available Room) analytics.
- Real-time Balance Sheet, Income Statement, Trial Balance, and Account Ledgers.
- PDF, Excel, and Word multi-section financial reports generation.
